# Binance.Net

> A .NET client library for Binance spot, margin, USD-M futures, and COIN-M futures REST and WebSocket APIs.

## Library usage

- [Binance.Net skill](.claude/skills/binance-net/SKILL.md): Consumer conventions and task-specific guidance.
- [API surfaces](.claude/skills/binance-net/references/api-surfaces.md): Client roots, intent-to-method routing, and Shared APIs.
- [Usage examples](.claude/skills/binance-net/references/usage.md): Authentication, REST, WebSockets, and dependency injection.
- [Operational considerations](.claude/skills/binance-net/references/safety.md): Credentials, order handling, and retry decisions.

## Repository and reference

- [README](README.md): Overview, installation, release notes, and documentation site link.
- [Repository instructions](AGENTS.md): Development workflow and documentation ownership.
- [Client interfaces](Binance.Net/Interfaces/Clients/): Exact endpoint signatures and XML documentation.
- [Library project](Binance.Net/Binance.Net.csproj): Package version, dependencies, and target frameworks.
- [AI-friendly examples](Examples/ai-friendly/): Complete programs compiled by the documentation test.
- [Benchmarks](docs/binance-net-benchmark.md): Measurements, methodology, and reproduction details.
